design.reference: New original deterministic material-modal and seeded-air synthesis. No samples, copied melody, or timbre inherited from rejected v2-v4 cast recipes.
design.gameplay: AscendanceCasterItem latches each press; EquipmentWeaponService.castMagic dispatches weapon.cast.release only after successful bolt spawn. A rapid semi-automatic short-range launch, not charge-up or impact.
design.runtimeHandoff: Use existing accepted-launch world cue once per successful cast. Review existing fallback pitch 1.6 before selecting this unity-pitch authored file; no cooldown-rejected or failed-spawn playback. Keep projectile impact separate.
design.revisionRequest: Keep selected B character; slightly reduce hissing air rush and lift only the tonal layers.
design.comparison: Refinement of selected concept B, not another alternative concept. Compare original r0001 then revised r0002 at their authored levels.
design.title: Hollow air launch - gentler air, lifted resonance
design.description: The selected hollow launch with a little less air rush and a slightly higher shell resonance. Its opening, pressure shape and short timing remain the same.

levelCalibration.method: Preserve original layer balance except requested reductions; no compensating normalization or boost.
